fields.label: Gross Weight
fields.description: Hidden 2026-09-15 - no longer part of the Finish Weight calc, per your instruction.

fields.label: Finish Weight (KGs)
fields.description: = (Towel Costing Sheet's Finish Weight for this row's Article / 1000) x Received Qty. Recomputed automatically on every save.

fields.label: Rolls (Received)
fields.description: Cumulative Rolls received against this row's Dyeing Contract Item can never exceed the Rolls issued - enforced on submit.

fields.label: Weight (kg) (Received)
fields.description: Cumulative Weight received against this row's Dyeing Contract Item can never exceed the Weight issued - enforced on submit.

fields.label: Weight Actual (Lbs)
fields.description: = Weight (kg) (Received) x 2.2046. Recomputed automatically on every save. Added 2026-09-15.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Fetched from the matching Dyeing Contract Item row.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: = Rate x Weight Actual (Lbs). Rate is per LBS, not per piece - fixed 2026-09-16 (was wrongly Rate x Received Qty).

fields.label: Dyeing Contract Item Row
fields.description: Internal - the Dyeing Contract Item row this was fetched from, so Received Qty/Rolls/Weight can be rolled back up into it on submit/cancel.

fields.label: Greige Batch
fields.description: Internal - consumed on the Repack Stock Entry.

fields.label: Color Batch
fields.description: Internal - produced on the Repack Stock Entry. Also what Dyed Fabric Issuance tags its own transfer with.

fields.label: Fabric Issuance Pcs
fields.description: Internal - how much of this row's Received Qty has already been sent out on a Dyed Fabric Issuance. Never exceeds Received Qty - enforced on Dyed Fabric Issuance submit.

fields.label: Fabric Issuance Rolls
fields.description: Internal - how much of this row's Rolls (Received) has already been sent out on a Dyed Fabric Issuance.

fields.label: Fabric Issuance Weight (kg)
fields.description: Internal - how much of this row's Weight (kg) (Received) has already been sent out on a Dyed Fabric Issuance.
